scope: Structured product scenarios and runner contracts. All required sources and frozen reference inputs are in the package; no Legacy archive or Git object dependency.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle matching graphical Editor. Run verify immediately after one normal script recompile, without user edits in between.
scenarios.setup: Create one owned 768px document and pixel history, with exact snapshots in Temp/WhimTex.
scenarios.teardown: Intentionally retains the named fixture and its Undo until paint-tile-history-reload-verify cleans them up.

scenarios.prerequisites: Prepared fixture and completed script recompile. Refuses Undo if another action changed the current group name.
scenarios.setup: Find only the unique owned document named by the preparation receipt; verify precise pixels, Undo and Redo.
scenarios.teardown: Destroy the owned document and cursor, clear only their Undo, erase the fixture receipt; keep reports in Temp/WhimTex.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; large cases require at least 7 GB VRAM. Run one large case per command.
scenarios.setup: Owned detached drawing documents. Compare block history, masks, low flow and HDR; exercise native Undo only for owned objects. No windows or user document mutations.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers/writes; clear Undo only on owned objects; destroy owned documents, textures and history cursors. Retain reports in Temp/WhimTex/paint-tile-history.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; large cases require at least 7 GB VRAM. Run one large case per command.
scenarios.setup: Owned detached drawing documents. Compare block history, masks, low flow and HDR; exercise native Undo only for owned objects. No windows or user document mutations.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers/writes; clear Undo only on owned objects; destroy owned documents, textures and history cursors. Retain reports in Temp/WhimTex/paint-tile-history.

scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers/writes; clear Undo only on owned objects; destroy owned documents, textures and history cursors. Retain reports in Temp/WhimTex/paint-tile-history.

scenarios.setup: Owned detached drawing documents. Compare block history, masks, low flow and HDR; exercise native Undo only for owned objects. No windows or user document mutations.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers/writes; clear Undo only on owned objects; destroy owned documents, textures and history cursors. Retain reports in Temp/WhimTex/paint-tile-history.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; follow with async-verify after Editor updates.
scenarios.setup: Owned 1536px HDR drawing queues three wide strokes without draining; save exact expected GPU bytes.
scenarios.teardown: Intentionally retain the GUID-owned fixture for async-verify. No user documents/windows.

scenarios.prerequisites: Prepared async fixture; allow several seconds of Editor updates between the separate prepare and verify commands.
scenarios.setup: Verify pending pages completed through Editor updates and stored CPU bytes equal GPU bytes.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned writes, remove only owned Undo and destroy the GUID-owned fixture.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor with asynchronous readback support.
scenarios.setup: Owned 1536px SDR/HDR sources; six immediate wide masked strokes, tiny flow and eraser. Check nonblocking completion below the staging budget, bounded overflow, immediate Undo and exact revision-by-revision Redo.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers and writes; clear only owned Undo and dispose fixtures.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor.
scenarios.setup: Owned 518px patterned SDR/HDR sources; compare complete Half images and exact storage after Undo/Redo, including partial edge tiles and corrupt history rejection.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned writes and transfers; clear only owned Undo and dispose fixtures.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; at least 7 GB VRAM. One large case per command.
scenarios.setup: One owned 8K RGBA32 noise source, 2048px brush, fractional mask and opacity. One full upload at initialization only.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers/writes; clear Undo only for owned objects; dispose all fixtures. Retain stage profiles in Temp.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle matching Editor. Portable managed buffers only.
scenarios.setup: Compare supported lossless codecs on owned zero, smooth and random buffers.
scenarios.teardown: Dispose streams; retain timings in Temp/WhimTex/paint-tile-history.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; large cases require at least 7 GB VRAM. Run one large case per command.
scenarios.setup: Owned detached drawing documents. Compare block history, masks, low flow and HDR; exercise native Undo only for owned objects. No windows or user document mutations.
scenarios.teardown: Drain owned transfers/writes; clear Undo only on owned objects; destroy owned documents, textures and history cursors. Retain reports in Temp/WhimTex/paint-tile-history.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor with current drawing shaders.
scenarios.setup: Detached 128/96 pixel drawing fixtures; old Half staging versus matching staging; 240 low-flow masked strokes including erasing; float conversion oracle and signed HDR. No Undo, windows, input or user documents.
scenarios.teardown: Release owned GPU textures and restore caller render state. Keep a uniquely named JSON report in project Temp/WhimTex/drawing-readback-format.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; profiler recording disabled.
scenarios.setup: One detached drawing surface/storage; two warmup pairs and six measured AB/BA pairs. Full readback is the measured operation. No Undo, windows, input or user documents.
scenarios.teardown: Release owned textures and restore render state; retain unique JSON timing report under Temp/WhimTex/drawing-readback-format.

scenarios.prerequisites: Passed 512 smoke; idle graphical matching Editor; profiler disabled; at least 7 GB reported VRAM.
scenarios.setup: One detached 8K source/storage and exactly one matching-format readback/upload per command. No full-size managed arrays, Undo, windows, input or user documents. Allow Editor updates between invocations; never repeat uploads in one command.
scenarios.teardown: Release owned textures and restore render state; retain unique JSON timing report under Temp/WhimTex/drawing-readback-format.

scenarios.prerequisites: Passed 512 smoke; idle graphical matching Editor; profiler disabled; at least 7 GB reported VRAM.
scenarios.setup: One detached 8K source/storage and exactly one original Half-staging readback/upload. Allow Editor updates between commands. No Undo, windows, input or user documents.
scenarios.teardown: Release owned textures and restore render state; retain unique JSON report under Temp/WhimTex/drawing-readback-format.

scenarios.prerequisites: Passed 512 smoke; idle graphical matching Editor; profiler disabled; at least 7 GB reported VRAM.
scenarios.setup: Detached 8K HDR control with unchanged Half staging; exactly one readback/upload per command. Allow Editor updates between invocations. No full-size managed arrays, Undo, windows, input or user documents.
scenarios.teardown: Release owned textures and restore render state; retain unique JSON timing report under Temp/WhimTex/drawing-readback-format.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical matching Editor; profiler recording disabled; 8K requires at least 7 GB reported VRAM.
scenarios.setup: Detached Drawing models, authenticated baseline shaders and transient GPU textures. No windows, input, user documents or assets.
scenarios.teardown: Release all owned textures/materials/shaders and restore caller render state.
